plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-15 from the official University of Washington Bothell degree-map PDF 'B-Global-Studies-Degree-Map-2022.pdf' (printed footer 'Last updated: 9/22/2022'), hosted on uwb.edu. The map's title block prints only 'Global Studies'; the BA is the degree in the official UW Bothell degree list for this program. Filed under catalog_year 2022-2023: this is an ARCHIVED map, not the current catalog. The current UW Bothell catalog is 2026-2027, and the degree maps the site currently links to are UW NetID SharePoint Word documents and MyPlan, both login-walled; no login was attempted, so the public 2022 PDF is the newest publicly verifiable official term-by-term map for this program. The map calls itself 'a suggested schedule of courses based on degree requirements' and 'not a substitute for academic advising' (printed on the map). UW Bothell is a quarter-system school; the 12 blocks below are the map's 12 quarters (Autumn/Winter/Spring, Years 1-4) in printed order. The map prints no per-term totals and no degree total. No parenthetical credit number is printed anywhere on this map (the '(min 2.0)' on BIS 300 and '(min 2.5)' on BIS 499 are grade notes, not credit numbers), so under the printed rule every slot is 5 credits, each quarter sums to 15 and the plan to 180, the standard UW Bothell bachelor's total. The map prints no course titles for BIS 300, BISGST 303 or BIS 499; they are recorded as 'no title printed on the degree map' rather than sourced elsewhere. Markers are disclosed, not recorded as prerequisites (the map prints no course-to-course prerequisite chain, so no prereqs are recorded): the diamond means 'Prerequisite: Must be completed prior to applying for a major'; the checkmark means 'Milestones: Courses and special requirements necessary to timely progress through and complete a major'; the star means 'See list of choices' — those lists are not printed on the map, so star-marked slots list no options; the four-point marker means 'May be fulfilled with Discovery Core'. No GPA/application note and no per-year note is printed on this map. Generic and category slots (NSc, A&H, RSN, Recommended prep course, GST Coursework, IAS Coursework, Skills & Methods, IPR Course, Diversity Course, Elective) are transcribed with their printed wording as choice slots with unique synthetic codes.
